title: Agentic Trading: When LLM Agents Meet Financial Markets

task.value: A systematic survey synthesizing the literature on LLM-based agentic trading systems through an Architecture–Capability–Adaptation framework, including evaluation practices.
task.quote: This survey provides a comprehensive, systematic, and forward-looking synthesis of the rapidly evolving landscape of agentic trading.

architecture.value: Survey framework (A-C-A): Architecture (perception, memory, reasoning, execution), Capability (alpha discovery, portfolio optimization, risk control), Adaptation (ICL, SFT, RL, multi-agent coordination, self-evolution).
architecture.quote: We structure the literature through a unified Architecture–Capability–Adaptation (A-C-A) conceptual framework

data.value: Literature corpus: 246 candidate records, 185 included studies (80 primary empirical, 105 background) from ACM DL, IEEE Xplore, arXiv, SSRN, Google Scholar plus citation chaining.
data.quote: After deduplication and screening, the current ledger contains 185 included studies from 246 candidate records.

window.value: Literature search window 2022-01-01 to 2026-09-30: initial window to 2026-03-09, arXiv extension window 2026-03-10 to 2026-09-30.
window.quote: The formal search for contemporary trading-agent work covered records published from 2022-01-01 through 2026-09-30

headline_result.value: In the 80-study empirical subset: time split reported 50/80 (62.5%), transaction costs 47/80 (58.8%), universe/survivorship 48/80 (60.0%), execution semantics 47/80 (58.8%).
headline_result.quote: Across the pooled 80-study empirical subset, reported protocol-field coverage includes time-consistent split discipline (62.5%), explicit transaction-cost modeling (58.8%), universe survivorship controls (60.0%), and execution semantics (58.8%).

uncertainty.value: Extraction-level audit of 15 fixed-seed records (seed = 20260426) with 150/150 field comparisons agreeing; a 182-record screening-boundary audit; not a representative reliability estimate.

limitations.value: Search windows are not matched (multi-database vs arXiv only); extension cohort coded in single pass and more preliminary; A-C-A reclassification not randomly sampled and inter-rater agreement not assessed.
limitations.quote: The windows are not matched search samples: the initial window spans multiple databases and citation chaining, whereas the extension uses arXiv only.

release.value: Registry, protocol tables, and coding materials provided as Supplementary Materials S1–S3; anonymized repository with materials and LaTeX source to be released upon acceptance.
release.quote: An anonymized repository containing the same materials and the LaTeX source will be released upon acceptance, subject to journal policy and anonymization requirements.
